messages:
Maya Chen: 👋 kicking off onboarding for Gatekeeper Systems — incoming customer PM is Luca. Goal: get prod-ready inference pipeline w/ dedicated capacity in 30 days.
Rohan Patel: ✅ noted. I'll own model integration and staging infra. Need API key access and sample traffic profile from Luca.
Luca Romano: Thanks Maya. We can share traffic profile by EOD today. Primary SLA: p99 latency < 200ms for 512-token responses.
Jill Park: I'll run two enablement sessions: (1) admin & RBAC walk-through (2) ops playbook + incident drills. Prefer week 1 and week 3.
Maya Chen: Success criteria (proposed): 1) Integration test pass (gen + embeddings) 2) Canary at 10% for 48h with no errors 3) Cost per 1k tokens within committed range 4) Team runbook delivered. Agree?
Luca Romano: Agree with those. Add: training for our L2 on-call.
Rohan Patel: Practical items: we need sample model weights or selected model name, sequence length distribution, and expected concurrency. Also request: allowlist the Gatekeeper CIDR for staging.
Maya Chen: Action items + owners: - Luca: provide traffic sample and CIDR (due: 1767540000) - Rohan: setup staging endpoint & canary config (due: 1767590000) - Jill: schedule enablement sessions (due: 1767550000) - Maya: kickoff playbook + success criteria doc (due: 1767525000)
OnboardBot: Meeting scheduled: "Gatekeeper onboarding - sync 1" on 2025-11-04 16:00 UTC. Link: https://meet.redwood.ai/abcd1234
Rohan Patel: Quick note on risks: renewal risk flagged if canary fails or token cost > 20% over projection. I'll add observability hooks (tail latency histograms, token cost tags).
Maya Chen: Good call. Add risk mitigations: automatic fallback to quantized model variant, and traffic throttling policy.
Jill Park: For enablement, do you want recorded sessions + quiz? I can create a short eval to verify readiness before go-live.
Luca Romano: Yes please — recorded sessions + checklist would be great. We can sign off readiness on checklist.
Maya Chen: Tentative timeline: week 0: intake + creds, week 1: staging integration + session 1, week 2: canary + cost tuning, week 3: session 2 + runbook, week 4: go/no-go and cutover.
Rohan Patel: I'll push a canary config draft to the repo: git.redwood/sre/gatekeeper/canary.yaml — ping when ready for review.
Maya Chen: Who's field contact on Gatekeeper side for emergency access?
Luca Romano: That's me (Luca). Cell in case of emergency: +1-415-555-0123.
Maya Chen: Great. One more: please confirm whether Gatekeeper wants logs forwarded to their Splunk/DFW instance or just summary metrics.
Luca Romano: Splunk forwarding preferred for first 2 weeks.
Rohan Patel: Noted. I'll open support ticket for syslog forwarding and add retention policy.
Maya Chen: OK team — I'll assemble the onboarding playbook doc and drop it in the Gatekeeper workspace. We'll reconvene tomorrow after traffic sample lands. 🚀
Luca Romano: Thanks all, looking forward to it.
Jill Park: 👍
Maya Chen: Closing loop: deliverables and due dates in the doc. If anything slips tag @Maya.
OnboardBot: Reminder set for 1767543600 to check traffic sample submission.
